messages.subject: Sustainability Executive | ESG, Corporate Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Tyler,

GS2's executive-search work across sustainability, ESG, responsible business, renewables and corporate affairs aligns directly with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where sustainability and corporate-affairs leadership must translate into measurable stakeholder and business outcomes. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
